_what: png copies of the paper's figures; the source next to each experiment is authoritative, re-run scripts/collect_paper_figures.py after regenerating one
_formats: png only here; the pdf / svg live at source_stem next to the experiment

figures.name: qcriterion_channel3d_D1024
figures.note: Q-criterion isosurface, one threshold for all four methods, taken as the 60th percentile of positive Q in the ground truth; see figure_q in the provenance.  A p90 rendering of the same snapshot exists next to the source if the surfaces are wanted sparser.

figures.name: qcriterion_channel3d_D512
figures.note: The Q-criterion figure at D=512.  Own snapshot, own threshold, both fixed from the ground truth exactly as at D=1024 -- each rung is internally fair rather than sharing a number across D.

figures.name: qcriterion_channel3d_D256
figures.note: The Q-criterion figure at D=256.  One of the four rungs -- 128, 256, 512, 1024 -- that let the gap between the methods be read against D.  Own snapshot, own threshold, both from the ground truth.

figures.name: qcriterion_channel3d_D128
figures.note: The Q-criterion figure at D=128, the lowest of the four rungs.  Own snapshot, own threshold, both from the ground truth.

figures.name: isosurface_uprime_channel3d_D1024
figures.note: u' isosurfaces at +/- the same threshold for all four methods, the warm half of jet for positive and the cool half for negative, each ramped by wall-normal position over z/h in [0,0.5]; see figure2 in the provenance.  Same snapshot, camera and crop as the Q-criterion figure, which takes the whole of jet because Q has no sign to carry.

figures.name: isosurface_uprime_channel3d_D512
figures.note: The u' isosurface figure at D=512, one of the four rungs that pair with the Q-criterion series.  Same jet halves and z/h in [0,0.5]; own snapshot and own threshold, both from the ground truth.

figures.name: isosurface_uprime_channel3d_D256
figures.note: The u' isosurface figure at D=256, one of the four rungs that pair with the Q-criterion series.  Same jet halves and z/h in [0,0.5]; own snapshot and own threshold, both from the ground truth.

figures.name: isosurface_uprime_channel3d_D128
figures.note: The u' isosurface figure at D=128, one of the four rungs that pair with the Q-criterion series.  Same jet halves and z/h in [0,0.5]; own snapshot and own threshold, both from the ground truth.

figures.name: isosurface_uprime_channel_yz_D256
figures.note: u' isosurfaces of ONE DNS snapshot whose 256 x-planes were each reconstructed independently by the y-z models, then stacked.  Nothing in POD, the CNN or OPINE couples neighbouring planes, so the streamwise coherence of these surfaces is earned rather than built in.  Same threshold, camera and z/h in [0,0.5] jet colouring as the 3-D isosurfaces.

figures.name: latent_directions_kolmogorov_D64
figures.note: decoded latent directions: one reduced coordinate of each method activated at one training standard deviation and mapped back to the vorticity plane.  Rows POD / CNN / OPINE, columns the four leading directions, all three methods at the real dimension D=64.  POD comes from the exact basis and its leading directions do not move with the truncation rank.  Deliberately separate from the summary figure.
